title: Electrician
what: Installs and tests the wiring and electrical systems inside homes and buildings.

title: Bricklayer
what: Builds and repairs walls and structures using brick, block and stone.

title: Roofer
what: Fits and repairs roofs, including the insulation work needed for energy-efficient homes.

title: Quantity surveyor
what: Works out how much a building project will cost and keeps it on budget.

title: Mechanical or electrical engineer
what: Designs and plans the building services, from wiring to heating systems, in construction projects.

title: HGV driver
level: Level 2 driving qualification plus Class 1 licence
what: Drives large goods vehicles delivering products across the country.

title: Warehouse operative
what: Picks, packs and moves stock around a warehouse, often using handheld scanners.

title: Business development executive
what: Finds new customers and contracts for a logistics or transport company.

title: Customer service advisor
what: Handles customer queries and deliveries, keeping clients informed and happy.

title: Healthcare assistant
level: Level 2 Diploma in Care (often trained on the job)
what: Supports nurses and carers with day-to-day patient or resident care, often needing no prior qualification.

title: Registered nurse
what: Assesses, treats and cares for patients in hospitals, care homes or the community.

title: Senior care worker
level: Level 3 Diploma in Health and Social Care
what: Takes on extra responsibility for planning care and supervising junior staff in a care setting.

title: Registered care manager
level: Level 5 Diploma in Leadership for Health and Social Care
what: Runs a care home or care service, managing staff, budgets and quality of care.

title: Mechanical or electrical engineer
what: Designs, tests and improves machinery, products and production processes.

title: Electronics or electrical technician
what: Assembles, tests and repairs electronic and electrical equipment such as circuit boards.

title: Welder or metal fabricator
what: Joins and shapes metal parts to build machinery, vehicles and structures.

title: CNC machinist
what: Sets up and runs computer-controlled machines that cut and shape precision parts.

title: Mechatronics or robotics technician
what: Installs and maintains automated machinery that combines mechanical, electrical and computer systems.

title: Cybersecurity analyst
what: Protects an organisation's systems and data from hackers and cyber-attacks.

title: Data analyst
what: Collects and interprets data to help a business make better decisions.

title: Cloud engineer
level: Level 4 apprenticeship plus vendor certification (e.g. AWS)
what: Builds and manages the online systems businesses use instead of their own servers.

title: IT support technician
what: Helps colleagues and customers fix computer, network and software problems.

title: Software developer
what: Writes and tests the code behind websites, apps and business systems.

title: Digital marketing executive
what: Runs social media, search and online advertising campaigns for a brand or client.

title: Sound or lighting technician
what: Sets up and runs the sound or lighting for live events, TV, film or theatre.

title: Graphic or motion designer
what: Creates visual designs and animations, increasingly working alongside AI tools.

title: Video editor
what: Cuts and finishes video footage for adverts, social media, TV and film.

title: Commis chef
what: Learns the basics of professional cooking, prepping ingredients under a senior chef.

title: Chef de partie
level: Level 3 apprenticeship or City & Guilds qualification
what: Runs a section of a professional kitchen, such as sauces or pastry.

title: Hospitality supervisor
what: Leads a small team in a hotel, restaurant or bar during a shift.

title: Hospitality or hotel manager
what: Manages the day-to-day running of a hotel, restaurant or venue.

title: Trainee solicitor
level: Degree plus SQE, or solicitor apprenticeship (Level 7)
what: Trains to qualify as a solicitor, gaining the qualifying work experience needed to sit the SQE.

title: Accounts assistant
what: Supports a finance team with invoices, payroll and basic bookkeeping.

title: Chartered accountant
level: Level 7 apprenticeship or degree plus ACCA/ICAEW
what: Prepares and checks financial accounts and advises businesses on tax and money matters.

title: Business development executive
what: Builds relationships with new clients to win business for a firm.
